3968-4050-4078-6634.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 4 or higher.
3968-4050-4078-6634.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Grave Titan and the two Zombies, adding {B}{B}{B}
When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers three times, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life for each trigger.
Repeat.

4053-4336-6989-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

620-2111-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

489-1621-3375-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1558-2097-3478-3875-4231.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Jolene.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2511-4907-6747-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
2511-4907-6747-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Sami. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static effect.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

3519-7182-7252.description:
Cast Grave Sifter for its evoke cost by paying {4}.
When Grave Sifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Grave Sifter.
When Grave Sifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Grave Sifter with haste.
When the Grave Sifter token enters, it triggers, returning Grave Sifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Food Chain by exiling the Grave Sifter, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Repeat.

57-4785-4846-5904.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
57-4785-4846-5904.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2457-4289-6705-7060.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2919-3490-4050-4476.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3490-4050-4476.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1651-2573-2638-5334-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2573-2638-5334-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-2573-2638-5334-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Roaming Throne, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

3094-3649-5334.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls three nontoken creatures that they own and that are not commanders.
3094-3649-5334.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Etrata, triggering its ability twice due to Roaming Throne.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying either of Etrata's triggers.
Resolve all Etrata triggers, exiling three creatures an opponent controls and putting hit counters on them, and then causing that opponent to lose the game.

290-3767-3918-5396.description:
Cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Dreamstone Hedron's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-2011-4076.easyPrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos.
1308-2011-4076.description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block and kill it.
Najeela and Burakos triggers.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating two 1/1 Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Burakos trigger, creating eight Treasure tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose 4 life.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

requires.n: Vehicle with MV >= 3 and a Crew Ability

5147-5747-6243--123.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the Vehicle with MV >= 3.
The number of artifacts you control is equal to or greater than the Vehicle's crew number minus 2.
5147-5747-6243--123.description:
Cast the Vehicle by paying its mana cost.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Activate the Vehicle's crew ability by tapping the Construct, causing the Vehicle to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Vehicle.
When the Vehicle dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the Vehicle from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not be an Angel because the Vehicle is no longer a creature and cannot gain creature types.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1429-4875-5147-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-4875-5147-5402.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

710-2921-4775.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

101-1719-2628-6185.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in hand.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
101-1719-2628-6185.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands' cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it due to New Perspectives.
Escape Protocol and Vizier of Tumbling Sands trigger.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbing Sands trigger, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Reoslve the Escape Protocol trigger, blinking Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Vizier of Tumbing Sands from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the cycling ability from step 2, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2438-2757-3327.notablePrerequisites:
You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
You control a basic Mountain.
2438-2757-3327.description:
Activate a basic Mountain, adding {R}.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Dargo, untapping a basic Mountain.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2079-3259-5768.notablePrerequisites:
Origin of the Hidden Ones has exactly two lore counters on it.
You control at least one Assassin that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-3259-5768.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Origin of the Hidden Ones' third chapter ability triggers, causing you to create an Assassin token whenever an Assassin attacks this turn and sacrifice Origin of the Hidden Ones.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached, and at least one Assassin if the creature with Breath of Fury attached isn't an Assassin, as attackers.
Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1074-4222-4772.description:
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping King Macar.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, exiling target creature and creating two Gold artifact tokens.
Activate the Golds by sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat as desired.
You may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1349-1999-2793-4241-4659.manaNeeded: {1}{U} the first turn, with {6}{U} available each extra turn
1349-1999-2793-4241-4659.notablePrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
1349-1999-2793-4241-4659.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Athreos' second ability triggers, putting a coin counter on Ugin's Nexus.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, adding {C}{C}.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Athreos' third ability triggers, causing you to return Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it and returning Ugin's Nexus to your hand, choosing to not put an artifact onto the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

1823-3432.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls a creature with toughness less than twenty.
1823-3432.description:
Cast Star of Extinction by paying {5}{R}{R}, destroying target land, and then dealing 20 damage to each creature and each planeswalker.
For each creature opponents control that is dealt excess damage, Fall of Cair Andros triggers, creating a 0/0 Army if you dont control one, and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on an Army you control equal to the excess damage.

65-717-2628-3242-5181.description:
Activate Zagoth Triome's cycling ability by paying {1} and discarding it.
Bone Miser and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Golgari Findbroker.
Golgari Findbroker enters the battlefield, returning Zagoth Triome from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Zagoth Triome ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

678-2034-2226.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{R}{G}{W}.
678-2034-2226.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control can tapping them, adding at least {5}{R}{G}{W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Zacama, adding {C}{C}.
Zacama dies, triggering Enduring Renewal, returning Zacama to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Zacama by paying {6}{R}{G}{W}.
Zacama triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Zacama's abilities.

700-1110-1339.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
700-1110-1339.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with haste.The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Terror of the Peaks, dealing 1 damage to Body of Knowledge.
Body of Knowledge triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

406-3017-4869.notablePrerequisites:
An additional card in hand.
The number of cards in library is greater than each opponent's life total.
Tandem Lookout paired with Glint-Horn Buccaneer.
406-3017-4869.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a card.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Tandem Lookout triggers for each opponent dealt damage.
Resolve one trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Holding priority, repeat.
Repeat.

1283-1987-2427-3277.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Izzet Chronarch, blinking them.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.

2730-4050-5237.easyPrerequisites: You had a permanent leave the battlefield this turn.
2730-4050-5237.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Renegade Rallier.
When Renegade Rallier dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Renegade Rallier
Repeat.

3005-3693.notablePrerequisites: Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
3005-3693.description:
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any creature an opponent controls.
Walking Ballista triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat as desired.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

317-2034-3490.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
317-2034-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any creature besides Mazirek, adding {C}{C}.
Mazirek triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers at least once, allowing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo token.
Repeat any number of times.
If you started this combo controlling at least three creatures total, once you have infinite mana, you may pay for multiple Animation Module triggers in step 3, creating infinite creature tokens.
